biotools.summary: CellFreeGMF is a tool that uses Graph Matrix Factorization (GMF) to identify cell-free RNA (cfRNA) biomarkers and analyze the specific cell types that contributed these biomarkers, linking liquid biopsy data to cellular origin and disease state.
